items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: Lindbergh was the first person to fly there.

ctx.x: Uh, there are ways of treating things like that and straightening them out, and I really should, uh...

Uh, oh, this is the kind of thing I like to drag out once in a while, because everybody thinks, not everybody, but most people think that, um, um, uh, what's the, what was the pilot, you know, the spirit of saying? Lindbergh. Lindbergh was the first person to fly there.
